title: Stop paying for editing courses
summary: Claude edits my reels, so I'm not paying for an editing course.
body: Claude edits my reels, so I'm not paying for an editing course.

My last take ran 57 seconds. The reel is 42 seconds with 16 cuts, from one prompt, and I never opened an editor. Claude Code and HyperFrames do the cutting, I only finish it in CapCut.
I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is the real workflow.
Built with @claudeai

Which expert myth would you call out? Tell me below. Comment CLAUDE and I'll send you my editing prompt and help you set up your own.
Follow @manrajtalks
guide: Use Claude Code to cut a talking-head take down to a tighter reel from one prompt, then finish it in CapCut. You need Claude Code, a recorded take, and CapCut.
1. Record your take on your phone or camera and save it as a video file in a folder Claude Code can open.
1. Install HyperFrames, the open-source video tool, and Claude Code, then open the folder in Claude Code.
1. Ask Claude Code to transcribe the take so it can see where each line starts and ends.
1. Give it one prompt: keep the best line each time, remove pauses and repeats, and target a set length.
1. Let Claude Code and HyperFrames render the cut with the motion graphics and icons you asked for.
1. Check the length and the number of cuts against your target, then ask for changes in plain English.
1. Import the render into CapCut for the final polish, such as captions and a sound.
Watch out: Do not judge by how fast it was; check that the cuts land on whole sentences and that nothing important was trimmed before you post.

```
You are helping me turn a talking-head video into a tighter short-form reel. I use Claude Code and HyperFrames, and I will finish the edit in CapCut.
My source file is <path to my video>. The take runs <length of take> and I want a reel of about <target length>, with roughly <number of cuts> cuts.
Do this:
1. Transcribe the video and show me the transcript with timestamps.
2. Choose the best delivery of each line, and remove pauses, filler words and repeats.
3. Add simple motion graphics and icons that match <my topic>, in <my brand colours>.
4. Render the result as a vertical 9:16 video using HyperFrames.
Constraints: cut only on whole sentences, keep the original audio untouched, and do not add facts that are not in my script.
Return the rendered file path, the final length, the number of cuts, and a list of what you removed so I can check it.
```
